fomod.Name: BeastHHBB and iBeasts - Project ja-Kha'jay Patch
fomod.Description: Fixes headless or wrong-faced Khajiit when Project ja-Kha'jay is installed with iBeasts - Interesting Npcs replacer and BeastHHBB. The beast mods win the look (race, head, face, hair, skin, outfit) of 40 NPCs: iBeasts for 27 Interesting NPCs Khajiit, BeastHHBB for the 11 caravan Khajiit, Mazaka and J'zargo. All other record data (factions, AI, USSEP fixes) is kept from Project ja-Kha'jay. Plugin only: iBeasts and BeastHHBB must win file conflicts against both Project ja-Kha'jay mods in your mod manager. Optional support, offered by the installer when installed: Hand to Hand - Trainers and Skill Books Addon.
